text: Ravens QB Tyler “Snoop” Huntley suffered a season-ending turf toe injury, per Adam Schefter. He’ll now require surgery — similar to Joe Burrow last year. He faces a long road ahead.

author: Adam Schefter
text:
Sources: tests revealed that Ravens’ QB Tyler “Snoop” Huntley suffered a season-ending turf toe injury. 

Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is out indefinitely with a thumb injury, Huntley’s season is over due to turf toe, and QB Joe Fagnano will start Thursday night vs. Jacksonville.

text:
Former Super Bowl champion QB Russell Wilson interviewed today for the head coaching job at North Carolina State, where he played three seasons, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. 

NC State now has two former NFL greats who starred there, Wilson and Philip Rivers, as prominent head-coaching candidates.
